title: Builder inbox and heartbeat activation
summary: The credential-isolated session protocol is installed, but it is not live until each staging builder writes its orientation report.
evidence: Each session uses a distinct Anthropic API credential stored only in that Unix user's protected home.
Each non-interactive session runs inside its own Unix and systemd sandbox boundary.
Builder sessions hold no GitHub credential and write only a local orientation report.
Iron Man remains the only merger and publisher through foreground workflows.
The watchdog heartbeat remains read-only for every external system.
limitations: Separate API credentials have not been installed and no isolated orientation session has run yet.
